thread:
Maya Rao: quick thought — we keep getting alerts about routes spiking burn but the dashboard heatmap buries prefetch credits. can we add a lightweight "cost-lighthouse" signal per route so ops can pin routes that should surface prefetch ROI first?
Kevin Lin: +1 for a signal, but what exact semantics? is it about ownership (who gets credited) or about visibility priority?
Maya Rao: both? idea is: a route-level flag controls (1) whether prefetch credits are included in the route's cost line and (2) whether that route bubbles to the top of the dashboard (visual priority). default off, opt-in per product.
Sudeep Patel: ownership is the hard part. right now prefetch savings are amortized to the first owner in the chain which is misleading for multi-model chains. we should emit a explicit header: X-Prefetch-Owner: team/<slug> and plumb it through telemetry.
Liz Chen: Console UX: show a tiny "prefetch ROI" sparkline next to the token burn sparkline + a 3-state badge (Net +, Net -, Neutral). makes it obvious when prefetch is actually saving tokens vs masking hotpath.
Kevin Lin: implementation sketch — add fields to the internal API and the telemetry event: 

```json
{
  "route_id": "teams/alpha/chat-complete",
  "cost_lighthouse": true,
  "prefetch_owner": "team/alpha",
  "prefetch_credit_tokens": 1245,
  "prefetch_savings_tokens": 987
}
```

Sudeep Patel: agree. but we should also keep backward compatibility. telemetry agent should infer prefetch_owner when header missing (best-effort) but mark as inferred. we need a migration plan otherwise billing/customer UX will flip.
Maya Rao: rollout thoughts — backend accepts new fields immediately, console ignores until the feature flag is turned on. rollout 3 phases: ingest (backend schema), expose (console visual behind feature flag), reconcile (sampling + historical recompute for last 7 days).
Liz Chen: small UX nit: when a route is cost_lighthouse=true, show a tooltip explaining that prefetch credits may be attributed differently than before and link to docs. also show sample-rate used for any recomputed historical numbers.
Kevin Lin: ops-bot FYI: adding route-level flag means we need a tiny admin API in the console for product owners to toggle. auth: project-admin only.
ops-bot: noted — added task INF-1207 to the data-ingest board: "support prefetch_owner header + cost_lighthouse flag". (reaction :white_check_mark:)
Sudeep Patel: measurement question — do we track both tokens saved and estimated latency benefit? prefetch can also hide downstream model hops which affect perf SLOs. suggest we include prefetch_latency_ms estimate when available.
Maya Rao: yes include latency estimate if model-side probe reports it. telemetry schema: prefetch_latency_ms (nullable). we can surface it as a secondary column in the route table.
Kevin Lin: one more: sampling. recomputing historical prefetch credits for all routes is heavy. plan: recompute for routes with cost_lighthouse=true only and sample 1% of others. happy?
Liz Chen: yep, and console should show a warning badge on any recomputed period "partial recompute".
Maya Rao: I'll draft the API PR and a short console mock. Sudeep, can you sketch the telemetry changes? Kevin, please add the admin toggle endpoints. aim to sync next Tue.
Sudeep Patel: will do — I'll post a small ingestion schema diff to the thread before EOD.
Kevin Lin: putting a tentative PR slot on my board for Wed morning.
Maya Rao: thanks — this should make triage way faster and reduce "ghost savings" confusion.
Liz Chen: love it. small ask for the mock: show both absolute tokens and "tokens per 1k invocations" so PMs can reason about ROI.
Maya Rao: noted. I'll include that.
Kevin Lin: cool. tagging @eng-platform for visibility.
